name: wayfinder/search_api_wayfinder
description: Search API backend plugin targeting the Wayfinder Solr-wire-compatible server.

autoload-dev._comment: The Drupal\* entries below are test-harness-only shims, not runtime dependency declarations. search_api ships no composer autoload of its own, and Drupal\file\ / Drupal\user\ (e.g. FileInterface, which transitively extends Drupal\user\EntityOwnerInterface) are core *module* namespaces; both are resolved at runtime by Drupal core's module classloader on a real site, so this unit-test sandbox needs Composer to find them at their vendor/ paths. A real site running composer/installers relocates them to web/modules/contrib/... and web/core/modules/..., where these hardcoded vendor/ paths would not resolve -- hence autoload-dev, not autoload. Guzzle is a genuine runtime dependency (via Drupal core's http_client service) so it does not need a shim; it resolves normally through vendor/.
